P2_gate: passed neutral standard mean threshold; options/order and confidence results are mixed
knockout: four-layer sliding windows, stride 1; last input token queries cannot attend to either terminal action; options unchanged
patch: neutral->familiar, same decoy token positions verified; K-only, V-only, both; all layers
baseline_readout: next-token 1/2 likelihood normalized across the two choices; record differences from P1 full generation
probe: separate blind/visible logistic probes, C=1, train 3 development trees and evaluate fourth; no test set
window_selection: report all windows; choose max accuracy recovery on dev. A concentrated window requires >=50% recovery and >0 restored accuracy, otherwise use all layers as user fallback
recovery: (intervened_acc-visible_acc)/(blind_acc-visible_acc); report raw values, undefined if denominator <=0
probe_interpretation: decodability alone is not causal evidence
